card.name: And after baseline monitoring timepoints
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after a baseline or pre-treatment timepoint in a monitoring instruction, just before "periodically", "weekly" or "during therapy".

modes.label: Baseline then follow-up
modes.description: "and" joins a baseline or start-of-treatment check to later repeat checks.
modes.example: Assess renal function at the beginning of the concomitant treatment<< and>> periodically thereafter.

modes.label: Before treatment then monitoring
modes.description: "and" follows a pre-treatment test and leads into ongoing monitoring.
modes.example: Monitor complete blood counts at baseline<< and>> weekly.

card.plain: It fires on the "and" in lab-monitoring instructions that say to test at baseline and then keep checking.
